# LLM Gateway

> A safety proxy that sits in front of a language-model API: prompt-injection defense, PII redaction, output-policy enforcement, and a semantic response cache. It ships with an adversarial test suite, so its defenses are measured.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway

## Source

- [src/llm_gateway/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/__init__.py): LLM Gateway - a safety proxy for language-model APIs, from scratch.
- [src/llm_gateway/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/cli.py): Command line interface for the language-model safety gateway.
- [src/llm_gateway/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/data.py): A labeled adversarial suite: injection attempts, PII prompts, and benign inputs.
- [src/llm_gateway/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/evaluation.py): Evaluation: injection-detection quality, PII-redaction recall, cache savings.
- [src/llm_gateway/gateway.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/gateway.py): The gateway pipeline: defend input, cache, call the model, enforce output policy.
- [src/llm_gateway/injection.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/injection.py): Prompt-injection detection over user input.
- [src/llm_gateway/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/llm_gateway/pii.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/pii.py): Detection and redaction of personally identifiable information.
- [src/llm_gateway/policy.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/policy.py): Output policy enforcement and a semantic response cache.
- [src/llm_gateway/provider.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/provider.py): The language-model provider interface, a deterministic fake, and a real client.
- [src/llm_gateway/rate_limit.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/rate_limit.py): Per-tenant rate limiting via a token bucket.
- [src/llm_gateway/resilience.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/resilience.py): Retry-with-backoff and cross-provider failover for the model backend.
- [src/llm_gateway/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the safety gateway.
- [src/llm_gateway/tenancy.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-gateway/blob/main/src/llm_gateway/tenancy.py): Per-tenant isolation on top of the single-tenant :class:`Gateway`.
